lecture_summary: Small-angle oscillations of simple and physical pendulums. The lecture connects gravitational restoring torque to rotational SHM, derives T = 2π√(Iₚ/(Mgℓ)), and applies it to a simple pendulum, rods with different pivots, and composite rod–mass and rod–disk systems. The main workflow is to identify the pivot, calculate total moment of inertia, use the parallel-axis theorem when needed, locate the combined center of mass, and then evaluate the period.
